items.source: Cassandra-specific extension of the CrudRepository interface that allows the specification of a type for the identity of the @Table (or @Persistable) type.
items.translation: Cassandra 专用的 CrudRepository 接口扩展，允许指定 @Table（或 @Persistable）类型的标识类型。

items.source: Cassandra repository interface using MapId to represent Ids.
items.translation: 使用MapId表示 ID 的 Cassandra 存储库接口。

items.source: Cassandra specific Repository interface with reactive support.
items.translation: 支持响应式特性的 Cassandra 专用 Repository 接口。

items.source: Annotation to declare a ConsistencyLevel for CQL queries executed through query methods.
items.translation: 用于声明通过查询方法执行的 CQL 查询的ConsistencyLevel的注解。

items.source: Apache Cassandra specific repository implementation.
items.translation: Apache Cassandra 专用仓库实现。

items.source: Spring Data's Cassandra abstraction.
items.translation: Spring Data 对 Cassandra 的抽象。

items.source: Ahead-Of-Time processors for Cassandra repositories.
items.translation: Cassandra 存储库的提前编译处理器。

items.source: CDI support for Apache Cassandra specific repository implementation.
items.translation: Apache Cassandra 特定仓库实现的 CDI 支持。

items.source: Support infrastructure for the configuration of Apache Cassandra specific repositories.
items.translation: 支持配置 Apache Cassandra 特定存储库的基础设施。

items.source: Query derivation mechanism for Apache Cassandra specific repositories.
items.translation: 针对 Apache Cassandra 特定存储库的查询推导机制。

items.source: Support infrastructure for query derivation of Apache Cassandra specific repositories.
items.translation: 支持从 Apache Cassandra 特定存储库推导查询的基础设施。

items.source: Annotation to declare filtering for a derived query.
items.translation: 用于声明派生查询过滤的注解。

items.source: Annotation to declare count queries directly on repository methods.
items.translation: 用于在仓库方法上直接声明计数查询的注解。

items.source: Annotation to declare exists queries directly on repository methods.
items.translation: 用于在仓储方法上直接声明存在查询的注解。

items.source: Annotation to declare finder queries directly on repository methods.
items.translation: 用于在仓库方法上直接声明查找查询的注解。

items.source: Enumeration to define statement idempotency.
items.translation: 用于定义语句幂等性的枚举。
